summary: The guest book app is built on `desk:apps:book` (40 lines) and works: names load from `desk:guestbook` on open, typing and Backspace edit the name on row 23, and Enter saves it and shows the newest name first. I left two test names (`Ana's` and `Bo`) on `desk:guestbook`, which didn't exist before, since the task allows that page to change.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest book'

task start()
  set names to []
  when exists('desk:guestbook')
    set names to lines(read('desk:guestbook'))
  done
  give {names: names, typed: ''}
done

task key(s, k)
  when k is 'enter'
    when s.typed is not ''
      add('desk:guestbook', s.typed)
      set names to s.names
      add s.typed to names
      set s.names to names
      set s.typed to ''
    done
  or when k is 'backspace'
    when s.typed is not ''
      set s.typed to slice(s.typed, 1, count(s.typed) - 1)
    done
  or when count(k) is 1
    set s.typed to s.typed & k
  done
  give s
done

task draw(s)
  show(1, 1, count(s.names) & ' guests')
  set row to 3
  for each n in reverse(s.names)
    when row < 23
      show(row, 1, n)
    done
    set row to row + 1
  done
  show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.typed)
done
